strings.Uma investigação sobre Junho de 2013 e o: An investigation of the June 2013 protests in Brazil and the media’s role in shaping them. Evidence, content analysis and new questions about Brazilian politics.
strings.Pesquisa sobre comunicação política, for: Research on political communication, public opinion formation and the role of the media in democracy. The laboratory analyzes the press and social media, connecting academic research with public debate.
strings.Criado em 2008, o grupo investiga políti: Founded in 2008, the group studies affirmative action policies and the representation of race and gender in education, media, politics and other areas of social life. It produces surveys and analyses of inequality in Brazil.
strings.Pesquisa e análise sobre o Legislativo b: Research and analysis of Brazil’s legislature and legislative behavior. The observatory connects academic knowledge with the study and monitoring of political institutions.
strings.Continuação das atividades do Manchetôme: A continuation of Manchetômetro’s work, analyzing content in the press and on social media. The project combines content analysis, valence analysis and AI-assisted coding tools.
strings.Rede internacional dedicada ao estudo do: An international network studying populism, polarization and post-truth in digital communication. The Brazilian team, based at IESP–UERJ, analyzes affective polarization and populist communication in the 2018 and 2022 elections.
strings.Pesquisa qualitativa sobre a interação e: Qualitative research on the relationship between race and political and electoral preferences. The study conducted 40 online focus groups across eight Brazilian state capitals.
strings.Coordenação de estudos coletivos sobre c: Coordination of collective studies of political and social concepts in Brazil, across two research phases. This work forms part of a broader research trajectory in conceptual history.
strings.Projeto comparativo sobre a relação entr: A comparative project on the relationship between populism and authenticity in different social contexts, with studies of Brazil, India and Ukraine and collaboration across countries and disciplines.
strings.Ascensão da extrema direita em perspecti: The rise of the far right in comparative perspective, focusing on Brazil and Germany: elections, parties, communication and policy agendas.
strings.Elaboração do projeto de tese: construçã: Development of a doctoral research proposal: formulating the research problem, reviewing the literature, organizing references and writing the introduction.
strings.Instituições e transformações da polític: Institutions and transformations in Brazilian politics since the New Republic, with research on elections, representation, polarization, the justice system, media and public policy.
strings.Crise democrática, erosão institucional,: Democratic crisis, institutional erosion, populism and the rise of the radical right, with case studies from Brazil, Germany and Latin America.
strings.Fundamentos da liberdade de expressão e: The foundations of freedom of expression and its relationship with equality, democracy, justice, tolerance and recognition, considering inequalities in access to communication.
strings.Literatura sobre a crise da democracia,: Literature on democratic crisis, the international rise of the far right and Bolsonarismo, combining comparison, critical analysis and hypothesis development.
strings.Desenvolvimento do projeto de tese por m: Development of a doctoral research proposal through readings, discussion of literature reviews and presentations of abstracts, introductions and research proposals.
strings.Teorias normativas da justiça e suas rel: Normative theories of justice and their relationship with racial inequality, human rights, recognition, tolerance and democracy.

strings.João Feres Júnior é professor titular de: João Feres Júnior is a Full Professor of Political Science at the Institute for Social and Political Studies of Rio de Janeiro State University (IESP–UERJ), where he has taught since 2010. His research encompasses political communication, political behavior, democratic theory, race relations and conceptual history.
strings.Graduou-se em Ciências Sociais e conclui: He earned a bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences and a master’s degree in Philosophy at the University of Campinas. He subsequently completed a master’s degree and a PhD in Political Science at the Graduate Center of the City University of New York, receiving his doctorate in 2003.
strings.Lecionou na Rutgers University, no Brook: He has taught at Rutgers University, Brooklyn College, IUPERJ and UNIRIO. He served as executive editor of UERJ University Press from 2019 to 2023 and, in 2023, as National Secretary for Analysis, Strategy and Coordination at the Brazilian Presidency’s Secretariat for Communication.
strings.No IESP, coordena o Grupo de Estudos Mul: At IESP, he coordinates the Multidisciplinary Study Group on Affirmative Action (GEMAA), the Brazilian Legislative Observatory (OLB) and the Laboratory for Media and Public Sphere Studies (LEMEP). Within LEMEP, he develops initiatives including Manchetômetro, the Public Debate Monitor and Politics in Networks.
strings.Além de livros e artigos acadêmicos, par: In addition to academic books and articles, he contributes to reports, bulletins and discussion papers on media and politics, legislative behavior and racial inequality. This work also involves training researchers and contributing to public debate.
strings.É coordenador do Instituto da Democracia: He coordinates the Institute for Democracy: Institutions, Behavior, Public Sphere and Diversity (INCT ID-ICED), based at IESP–UERJ. The institute studies challenges and threats to democracy in comparative perspective, connecting institutions, political behavior and the public sphere with inclusion and sustainability in Brazil and South America.
strings.Professor titular de Ciência Política do: Full Professor of Political Science at IESP–UERJ, where he has taught since 2010. He holds a PhD from the City University of New York and degrees in Social Sciences and Philosophy from the University of Campinas. He coordinates INCT ID-ICED, GEMAA, OLB and LEMEP.
strings.João Feres Júnior é professor titular de: João Feres Júnior is a Full Professor of Political Science at IESP–UERJ, where he has taught since 2010, and holds a PhD from the City University of New York. He coordinates INCT ID-ICED, GEMAA, the Brazilian Legislative Observatory and LEMEP, the laboratory responsible for Manchetômetro. His research covers political communication, political behavior, democratic theory, affirmative action, race relations and conceptual history. He is the author of Nas ruas e fora delas: Junho de 2013 revisitado (Autêntica, 2026).

shortBio: João Feres Júnior is a Full Professor of Political Science at IESP–UERJ, where he has taught since 2010, and holds a PhD from the City University of New York. He coordinates INCT ID-ICED, GEMAA, the Brazilian Legislative Observatory and LEMEP, the laboratory responsible for Manchetômetro. His research covers political communication, political behavior, democratic theory, affirmative action, race relations and conceptual history. He is the author of Nas ruas e fora delas: Junho de 2013 revisitado (Autêntica, 2026).
